item.title: Slay Your Way Book Launch at Oaxaca Mi Alma at The Moore Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - January 3, 2026 - Sandi Glandt celebrated the release of Slay Your Way, unveiling a practical roadmap designed to help women lead and perform at a higher level without burnout. The launch highlighted proven systems, real-life strategies, and the debut of The Busy Woman’s Cookbook, offering high-protein, quick meals to support high performance at home and beyond.
